YOUR LOCAL LOCKSMITH

Lock repairs & replacement

Repair a faulty lock, replace a cylinder or arrange lock changes when moving home. Get advice on a suitable replacement for your door.

Call 0203 7720564Send an enquiry

Repair or replacement?

A sticking key or unreliable latch does not identify a single fault. The locksmith checks the lock and how the door closes, then explains whether a repair, adjustment or replacement is appropriate.

Moving home or missing keys

Changing the relevant locks can give you control over who holds a working key. Tell us which entrance doors need attention and whether you want to discuss replacement cylinders or complete locks.

Choosing a suitable lock

The replacement must suit the door and its locking system. If you have an insurer’s lock requirements, share the wording before the visit so compatibility can be checked. Do not assume every lock fits every door.

Guide price

Lock replacement guide price from £65. The locksmith assesses the job and confirms the price before work starts.
